result.brief: 提出单一几何奖励（重叠校准的跨视角深度一致性），用于视频扩散模型的训练后与推理时对齐，提升4D生成几何一致性与视觉质量。
result.reason: Proposes a calibrated cross-view depth-consistency reward for video diffusion post-training and inference-time alignment to improve 4D/3D geometric consistency, directly serving video generation and 4D world modeling.
